This might be the most important AI thread you read this month, hands down

Compaction erases some things faster than others.

Pay attention, if your agent's safety rules live in an AGENTS‌.md or a CLAUDE‌.md.

This is one of the most common failure points in long-running AI agents right now.

Glad there is finally a paper measuring what context https://t.co/GLp01iyaP6

Claude Code's own /compact on Sonnet 4.6 preserves 53% of safety rules after 1 round. After 5 rounds, that's 10%.

A safety rule and an episodic log compete for the same tokens. When the budget overflows, both get summarized at the same rate.

Their fix, Knowledge Triage, routes https://t.co/yP3hxmDE6I

Paper here: https://t.co/9DiZp9SNmq

Free prompts and guides at https://t.co/QbTXyXRlOk

Follow if you'd rather find out your CLAUDE‌.md rules got compacted away in testing, not in production.
